title.zh-CN: 糖尿病背景下消瘦与水肿 · 73岁男性
title.en: Weight loss and oedema in longstanding diabetes · man aged 73

summary.zh-CN: 长期糖尿病不能自动解释新近显著消瘦、血压降低及多器官线索。
summary.en: Longstanding diabetes does not automatically explain new marked weight loss, lower BP and multi-organ clues.

chiefComplaint.en: One year of weight loss and five months of leg oedema

triageNote.zh-CN: 体重一年下降约20 kg，水肿加重至阴囊与双腿。

prompt.zh-CN: 哪些组合要求超越糖尿病并发症？
prompt.en: Which combination requires looking beyond diabetic complications?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 系统性浸润或浆细胞疾病需评估
text.en: Assess systemic infiltrative or plasma-cell disease

feedback.zh-CN: 低电压与壁厚、舌大、消瘦及单克隆蛋白形成额外线索。
feedback.en: Low voltage with thick walls, macroglossia, wasting and monoclonal protein are additional clues.

text.zh-CN: 病程长即可将所有表现归于糖尿病
text.en: Long diabetes duration attributes every finding to diabetes

feedback.zh-CN: 不能解释所有不协调证据。
feedback.en: It does not explain the discordant findings.

text.zh-CN: EF正常就排除严重心脏病
text.en: Normal EF excludes important cardiac disease

feedback.zh-CN: 舒张和浸润性问题可保留EF。

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 证实淀粉样沉积及浆细胞克隆，但需可靠组织分型与现代疾病标准复核
text.en: Amyloid and a plasma-cell clone are established, while reliable tissue typing and modern disease criteria need review

feedback.zh-CN: 不能仅用单克隆条带自动确定每个器官的AL病理。
feedback.en: A monoclonal band does not prove AL histology in every organ.

text.zh-CN: 糖尿病肾病和肾淀粉样均已肾活检确证
text.en: Both diabetic and amyloid kidney disease are biopsy-proven

text.zh-CN: 无骨破坏可排除浆细胞疾病
text.en: No lytic lesions excludes plasma-cell disease

prompt.zh-CN: 如何兼顾心肾及血液风险？
prompt.en: How should cardiac, renal and haematological risks be coordinated?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 血液、心肾团队复核分型与器官分期，谨慎容量管理并监测低血压
text.en: Haematology and cardiorenal teams should verify typing/staging and manage volume with attention to hypotension

feedback.zh-CN: 历史MP化疗并非可直接复制的现行方案。
feedback.en: Historical MP chemotherapy is not a directly transferable current regimen.

text.zh-CN: 只要水肿就无限加大利尿
text.en: Oedema warrants unrestricted diuresis

feedback.zh-CN: 低压和心脏受累需要谨慎个体化。
feedback.en: Hypotension and cardiac involvement require careful individualisation.

text.zh-CN: 腿肿消退即可宣布全病缓解
text.en: Resolved leg oedema proves complete remission

feedback.zh-CN: 症状改善不替代心脏和克隆反应。
feedback.en: Symptomatic improvement does not establish cardiac or clonal response.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：识别糖尿病诊断无法充分解释的红旗。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：组织淀粉样分型、游离轻链比值、肾活检及现代骨髓瘤定义所需证据。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Identify red flags insufficiently explained by diabetes. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Amyloid tissue typing, free-light-chain ratio, renal biopsy and evidence required by modern myeloma definitions. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 报告诊断IgGλ浆细胞骨髓瘤并系统性淀粉样变；现代分型及肾病归因仍需复核。
conclusion.en: The report diagnosed IgG-lambda plasma-cell myeloma with systemic amyloidosis; contemporary typing and renal attribution need review.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 组织淀粉样分型、游离轻链比值、肾活检及现代骨髓瘤定义所需证据。
unknowns.en: Amyloid tissue typing, free-light-chain ratio, renal biopsy and evidence required by modern myeloma definitions.

references: 顾楠, 杨建梅, 吴红花, 欧晋平, 张俊清, 郭晓蕙. 一例老年糖尿病患者合并蛋白尿的诊治经过. 中华糖尿病杂志. 2013;05(10):644-646. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.1674-5809.2013.10.016.

American Society of Hematology. 2026 guidelines on diagnosis of light chain amyloidosis. Blood Adv. 2026;10(14):5113-5152. doi:10.1182/bloodadvances.2025017073. https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13425172/

notice.zh-CN: 教学脚本评估，并非经过验证的能力评分。
notice.en: A teaching-script measure, not a validated competency score.

unknowns.zh-CN: 组织淀粉样分型、游离轻链比值、肾活检及现代骨髓瘤定义所需证据。
unknowns.en: Amyloid tissue typing, free-light-chain ratio, renal biopsy and evidence required by modern myeloma definitions.

testUtterances.text: 一年瘦了多少，是刻意减重吗？
How much weight was lost in a year, and was it intentional?
体重下降是什么时候开始的？
When did the weight loss begin?
腿肿多久了，后来哪里也肿？
How long have the legs been swollen, and where did it spread?
水肿是不是逐渐加重？
Has the swelling progressively worsened?
不吃降糖药后血糖怎样？
What happened to glucose after stopping diabetes medicines?
什么时候发现降糖药不再需要原来的量？
When did the previous diabetes treatment seem no longer necessary?
手脚麻痛之外会头晕眼前黑吗？
Besides limb tingling, do you get dizziness or visual blackout?
手脚感觉和站立时不适怎样？
How have limb sensation and episodes of dizziness changed?
停降压药后血压怎样？
What happened to BP after medicines stopped?
以前高血压现在是否变低？
Has previously high BP become lower?
有没有腹泻或便秘交替？
Do diarrhoea and constipation alternate?
排便习惯最近如何变化？
How have bowel habits changed recently?
对哪些药物过敏？
Which medicines have caused allergy?
用药后出现过什么过敏反应？
What allergic reactions have occurred after medicines?
以前有没有家族病史方面的情况？
Could you describe any family illnesses?
以前有没有既往手术方面的情况？
Could you describe any earlier operations?
以前有没有日常用药清单方面的情况？
Could you describe any regular medicines?
以前有没有既往健康情况方面的情况？
Could you describe any previous health?
